text:
Maya (Finance): Heads up 12K invoice from NimbusWorks (INV-NW-1204) includes 20% UK VAT on sandbox credits. Vendor claims they charged VAT in error and asked us to process refund. Need docs before we credit. cc @Claire Legal @Owen Tax
InvoiceBot: Invoice INV-NW-1204 uploaded by @NimbusWorks \u2014 total: 200.00 (VAT: 33.33). File: invoice_NW_1204.pdf
Owen Tax: Checklist: 1) vendor VAT reg number (VIES check), 2) reissued invoice showing 0% VAT or reverse-charge wording, 3) copy of vendor's VAT returns/OSS report if they say they reported this under OSS, 4) customer VAT ID proving B2B. Without proof we can't reclaim VAT.
Claire Legal: For cloud credits sold to a UK-registered customer, reverse charge normally applies if supplier is outside UK. If NimbusWorks is UK-registered and billed UK VAT, then charge could be valid. We need to know the supplier's country of registration and whether the buyer entity is VAT-registered.
Luis (EMEA Ops): Vendor replied: "We're registered in Malta VAT MT55544433 and our billing system applied UK VAT due to customer country mismatch." They attached a screenshot and a copy of their Maltese VAT certificate.
Owen Tax: I'll run VIES on MT55544433. If VIES validates, request reissued invoice without UK VAT and an email from NimbusWorks explaining the misconfiguration. Also ask vendor to confirm they did NOT remit VAT to HMRC for that invoice.
Maya (Finance): Putting INV-NW-1204 on hold. SLA to vendor: 4 business days to provide: (a) VIES verification or nation certificate, (b) reissued invoice with reverse-charge text or 0% VAT, (c) confirmation of VAT remittance status.
Claire Legal: Suggested message to vendor (copy): "Please reissue INV-NW-1204 without UK VAT and include either: (i) 'Reverse charge 1 VAT to be accounted for by the recipient' and our VAT ID, or (ii) provide proof of refund to our account and evidence you didn't remit the VAT to HMRC. Attach VIES or national VAT certificate."
InvoiceBot: VIES lookup in progress by Owen Tax.
Owen Tax: Quick update 1 VIES returned MT55544433 as VALID. If they reissue with reverse charge we can clear the hold. I'll add the validation screenshot to the tax binder.
Maya (Finance): Thanks. I'll only process credit once the corrected invoice is uploaded or proof of refund is provided. Logging in refunds tracker and will close thread when bank shows refund. :white_check_mark:
